notes:           Vendored single-file C99 glTF 2.0 parser (.gltf JSON +
                 .glb binary; buffers from external .bin files, GLB BIN
                 chunks, and base64 data URIs via cgltf_load_buffers).
                 Zero sub-dependencies (chosen over tinygltf, which
                 bundles nlohmann/json and requires stb_image_write
                 wiring — smaller audit surface for the same feature
                 set). Used by the glTF loading layer
                 (include/objtomc/gltf.hpp + src/gltf.cpp) to import
                 Sketchfab downloads into the existing mesh::Mesh model.
                 Read-only per the tinyobjloader vendoring precedent
                 (DECISIONS.md 2026-06-18 "Vendoring pattern for
                 third-party C++ deps"); customisation only via the
                 upstream-blessed CGLTF_IMPLEMENTATION define in the
                 single wrapper TU (src/gltf.cpp). The git-sha above is
                 the load-bearing record; git-ref is informational.
